Date 17-6-32）
CHINESE PAPER ENCOURAGE STUDENTS TO FIGHT IN MANCHURIA
SHANGHAI, JUN. 15.
WHILE THERE HAVE BEEN INDICATIONS LATELY THAT
THE STORY TOLD BY DR. WELLINGTON KOO AND PUBLISHED IN
NATIVE PAPERS SINCE HIS XXXXRXM RETURN FROM MANCHURIA
HAS HAD THE EFFECT OF REVIVING THE ANTI-JAPANESE SENTI-
MENTS AMONG THE STUDENT CIRCLE, THE CHINESE NEWSPAPERS
HAVE LATELY BEGUN XXXXMXRXXXX OPENLY TO ENCOURAGE THE
STUDENTS TO ARM THEMSELVES AND GO TO MANCHURIA TO
ASSIST MA CHUANGSHAN AND OTHERS WHO ARE DEFYING THE
MANCHUKOU REGIME.
IN THIS MORNING'S ISSUE OF THE SIN WAN PAO, 15/6.
AN IMPASSIONATE APPEAL ADDRESSED TO THE NATION AT LARGE,
CALLING THE MASSES TO MAKE CONTRIBUTIONS TO PURCHASE
ARMS AND AMMUNITION IN ORDER TO CONTINUE THE 'WAR'
AGAINST THE MANCHUKOU, IS PROMINENTLY PRINTED IN
ITS EDITORIAL. THE PAPER, STRESSING THE NECESSITY OF
GIVING ACTIVE AID TO MA CHUAN-SHAN AND OTHERS WHO ARE
CONTINUING A SORT OF GUERILLA WARFARE IN MANCHURIA,
ASSERTS THAT UNLESS SUCH 'PATRIOTIC' AID IS NOT GIVEN,
THE WHOLE MANCHURIA WOULD BE PLUNGED INTO A VERITABLE
HELL. - PRESS UNION.

日期 1932年6月17日）
中文报纸鼓励学生赴满洲作战
上海，6月15日。
尽管近期有迹象表明，顾维钧博士从满洲返回后向本国报纸讲述的经历，已在学生群体中重新激起了反日情绪，但中文报纸最近已开始公开鼓励学生武装起来，前往满洲协助马占山及其他反抗伪满洲国政权的人士。
在6月15日的《新闻报》晨刊中，其社论显著刊登了一篇致全国同胞的激昂呼吁，号召民众捐款购买武器弹药，以继续对伪满洲国的“战争”。该报强调必须积极援助马占山及其他在满洲进行某种游击战的人士，并断言若不给予此类“爱国”援助，整个满洲将陷入真正的人间地狱。——联合通讯社。

June 15, 1932. Morning Translation

POLITICAL

China Times and other local newspapers

MOVEMENTS OF PRESIDENT LING SEN IN SHANGHAI.

Mr. Ling Sen, President of the National Government arrived in Shanghai on the night of June 13. At 7 a.m. yesterday Mr. Ling called on General Chen Ming Shu, Minister of Communications, at his residence at No. 75 Route de Say Zoong, to persuade him to withdraw his resignation. It is learned that General Chen has yielded to the President's request.

At 2 p.m. General Chen Ming Shu, accompanied by General Tsai Ting Kai, Commander of the 19th Route Army, called on Mr. Ling Sen on Route Pere Robert, French Concession.

At 4.30 p.m. President Ling proceeded to Route Moliere to call on Mr. Sun Fo but upon being informed that Mr. Sun was indisposed, he withdrew.

China Times publishes the following telegram from Nanking

DR. KOO'S VISIT TO NANKING.

With the arrival of Dr. Wellington Koo at Nanking, conferences were held by Wang Ching Wei, President of the Administrative Council, at which the future policy in regard to the North-Eastern affair was discussed. Wang Ching Wei, Dr. Lo Wen Kan, Li Shih Tseng, General Li Chi Sen and Dr. Wellington Koo flew to Kiukiang at 11.45 a.m. June 14 to hold a conference with General Chiang Kai Shek. Wang Ching Wei will return to Nanking on June 15.

On the morning of June 14 Dr. Wellington Koo received a telegram from Lord Lytton asking him to return to Peiping. Dr. Koo will fly to Shanghai via Nanking on June 15 where, after one day's rest, he will leave for Peiping by air.

Interviewed by a newspaper reporter, Dr. Wellington Koo made the following statement:- "I visited Nanking solely to make a report on the investigations in the Three Eastern Provinces and to give my personal views. Several conferences were held in Nanking at which the general principles were decided upon, but the views of General Chiang Kai Shek must be sought. We are leaving for Kiukiang to-day. While in the North-East, we were oppressed and insulted. Two foreign counsellors of the Chinese Delegation were similarly treated. Japan is already regarding China as a nonentity. I have always said that the North-Eastern affair is a question of life or death to China. The only thing for China to do is to unite against foreign aggression; the people should make sacrifices for the welfare of the country and should not entertain the idea that China cannot be conquered because of her vast area and population".

1932年6月15日。上午译件

政治类

《中国时报》及其他本地报纸

林森主席在上海的行踪。

国民政府主席林森先生于6月13日晚抵达上海。昨日上午7时，林先生前往赛仲路75号寓所拜访交通部部长陈铭枢将军，劝其撤回辞呈。据悉，陈将军已应允总统之请。

下午2时，陈铭枢将军由第十九路军指挥官蔡廷锴将军陪同，前往法租界罗伯特长路（Route Pere Robert）拜访林森先生。

下午4时30分，林主席前往莫利哀路（Route Moliere）拜访孙科先生，但得知孙先生身体不适后，随即离去。

《中国时报》刊登了来自南京的以下电文：

顾博士访问南京。

随着顾维钧博士抵达南京，行政院院长汪精卫主持召开了会议，讨论关于东北事态的未来政策。汪精卫、罗文干博士、李石曾、李济深将军及顾维钧博士于6月14日上午11时45分飞往九江，与蒋介石将军举行会议。汪精卫将于6月15日返回南京。

6月14日上午，顾维钧博士收到里顿勋爵的电报，要求其返回北平。顾博士将于6月15日经南京飞抵上海，休息一天后，将乘飞机前往北平。

顾维钧博士在接受报社记者采访时发表如下声明：“我此次访问南京， solely 是为了报告在东北三省的调查情况并陈述个人观点。在南京举行了数次次会议，确定了一般原则，但必须征求蒋介石将军的意见。我们今日启程前往九江。在东北期间，我们遭受压迫和侮辱。中国代表团的两位外籍顾问也受到了同样的待遇。日本已经视中国为无足轻重之物。我一贯认为，东北问题关乎中国的生死存亡。中国唯一要做的是团结起来抵抗外国侵略；人民应为国家的福祉做出牺牲，而不应抱有因中国幅员辽阔、人口众多便不可被征服的想法”。

pages.en:
June 16, 1932.                                      Afternoon Translation

MISCELLANEOUS

China Times and other local newspapers

DR. KOO AND CONDITIONS IN MANCHURIA.

Interviewed by local journalists at his
residence on Markham Road at 9 p.m. yesterday, Dr.
Wellington Koo made the following statement:-
"Recently I accompanied the Enquiry
Commission of the League of Nations to the Three
Eastern Provinces. During the seven weeks of
investigations there, I was greatly pained at what
I saw and heard. The pains and sufferings of the
Chinese Delegation are but shortlived compared with
the distressful condition and hardships of the
30,000,000 people of the Three Eastern Provinces.
I am a native of Kiangsu and I am glad to be back after
my seven weeks of hardships outside the Great Wall, but
I shall never forget the sufferings of the people of
the Three Eastern Provinces. I hope you will not
forget our brethren in the North-East. Shanghai
people should not take things easily because the
Three Eastern Provinces are several thousands of
miles away for Japan has already a concrete plan for the
invasion of China."

Q. What is the Government's plan for the recovery
of the Three Eastern Provinces?
A. The Government will exchange views with the
League's Enquiry Commission. The Commission,
during its stay in Japan, will exchange views
with the Japanese Government. After the
return of the Commission to Peiping, the Chinese
Government will again solicit the views of the
Commission in order to decide on the proper
measures.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers

THE REHABILITATION OF WOOSUNG AND SHANGHAI.

The Woosung and Shanghai War Zones
Commercial Restoration Committee held a meeting at
3 p.m. yesterday at its office No. 19 Hankow Road.
The meeting resolved that the National
Government be requested to issue $300,000,000 debenture
bonds to be used for the restoration of Woosung and
Shanghai; that the Shanghai Maritime Customs be
directed to appropriate $500,000 monthly for a period
of 50 years from the funds reserved for the payment of
interest on Government Bonds, and that all taxes in
the war zones be abolished.
pages.zh:
1932年6月16日。                                      下午译件

杂项

《中国时报》及其他本地报纸

顾博士与满洲局势。

顾维钧博士昨晚9时在其马克姆路寓所接受本地记者采访，发表如下声明：
“近期我陪同国际联盟调查团前往东北三省。在那里的七周调查期间，我所见所闻令我深感痛心。与中国代表团所受的痛苦相比，东北三省三千万民众的悲惨处境和苦难更为深重且持久。我是江苏人，很高兴在长城外历经七周艰辛后归来，但我永远不会忘记东北三省人民的苦难。希望你们不要忘记我们在东北的同胞。上海市民不应掉以轻心，因为虽然东北三省远在数千里之外，但日本已经有了具体的侵华计划。”

问：政府收复东北三省的计划是什么？
答：政府将与国联调查团交换意见。调查团在日本停留期间，将与日本政府交换意见。调查团返回北平后，中国政府将再次征询调查团的意见，以便决定适当的措施。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸

吴淞与上海的复兴。

吴淞上海战区商业恢复委员会于昨日下午3时在其汉口路19号办事处举行会议。会议决议请求国民政府发行3亿元公债，用于吴淞和上海的恢复工作；指令上海海关从预留用于支付政府债券利息的资金中，每月拨出50万元，为期50年；并废除战区内的所有税收。

pages.en:
June 16, 1932. Morning Translation

MISCELLANEOUS

Sin Wan Pao published the following comment on June 15:

APPEAL FOR SUPPORT FOR NORTH-EASTERN VOLUNTEERS.

After the Enquiry Commission of the League
of Nations returned to Peiping from the North-East, we
noticed from local newspapers that Dr. Wellington Koo
is reported to have said:- "30,000,000 people in the
North-East are living in hell, their sufferings are
beyond imagination. However, the youths are still
struggling hard. It is hoped that the nation will
devise ways and means as early as possible to rescue
these 30,000,000 brethren".
The above report must arouse general
indignation. Yet we regret to say that nothing has
been done to improve the situation.
After the September 18 incident, the
Government declared that military forces and diplomacy
will be used to deal with the incident; yet no troops
have been dispatched. As regards diplomacy, the
only thing that has been done is to invoke the League
of Nations. In other words, the Government does not
dare to resist the invaders in the North-East nor has
it decided upon any measures that will lead to a
solution of the trouble. The cry for the recovery
of the lost territory has become an empty word.
According to reports from Harbin, the
100,000 men of the Volunteer Army there are in need of
funds and arms, while the army under General Ma Chan
Shan is not in position to fight the enormous number
of well equipped Japanese troops.
In short, the Manchurian question is
becoming worse: and its solution will not depend upon
diplomacy nor upon the Government. The only hope for
China is for the military officers and troops to
volunteer for the defence of the country and for the
people throughout the country to go to the rescue of
the nation.
The military should refrain from
participating in civil wars but should mobilize
and reinforce the Volunteer Army at the front.
The people throughout the country should
unanimously make contributions for the purchase of
arms to be used in resisting the invasion. Unless
the people of the whole nation firmly resolve to make
sacrifices even of their lives, the "several million
square li of land" and the "30,000,000 of our brethren
in the North-East" will be lost to China.
pages.zh:
1932年6月16日。上午译件

杂项

《新闻报》于6月15日发表如下评论：

呼吁支援东北义勇军。

国际联盟调查团从东北返回北平后，我们从本地报纸上注意到，据报道顾维钧博士曾说：“东北三千万人民生活在水深火热之中，其苦难难以想象。然而，青年们仍在奋力抗争。希望国家能尽早想出办法，拯救这三千万同胞”。
上述报道必然激起普遍的愤慨。然而遗憾的是，并未采取任何措施来改善局势。
九一八事变后，政府宣称将动用军事力量和外交手段处理此事；然而并未派遣军队。至于外交方面，所做的唯一事情就是诉诸国际联盟。换言之，政府不敢在东北抵抗侵略者，也未决定任何能导致解决危机的措施。收复失地的呼声已成为空话。
据哈尔滨报道，那里的十万义勇军急需资金和武器，而马占山将军麾下的部队无力对抗装备精良的大量日军。
总之，满洲问题正日益恶化：其解决既不取决于外交，也不取决于政府。中国唯一的希望在于军官和士兵自愿保卫国家，以及全国民众投身救国运动。
军人应避免参与内战，而应动员并增援前线的义勇军。
全国民众应一致捐款购买武器，用于抵抗侵略。除非全国人民坚定决心，甚至不惜牺牲生命，否则“数百万平方里的土地”和“东北三千万同胞”将沦丧。
